title: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) - Unauthorized Profile Access
description:
The /profile/:id endpoint does not implement any authentication or authorization checks. Any unauthenticated user can access any user's profile by directly accessing the endpoint with a valid user ID. There is no verification that the requesting user is the profile owner or has permission to view that profile. This allows unauthorized access to all user accounts and their associated information.

The vulnerability permits:
- Viewing all user profiles and usernames without authentication
- Enumerating all users by incrementing or guessing IDs
- Collecting usernames for targeted attacks
- Discovering the flag displayed only to the first user
- Performing reconnaissance on all registered accounts without authentication

The application returns HTTP 200 with full profile data to any request, regardless of whether the user is authenticated or has authorization to view the profile.
impact:
An attacker can:
1. Access and view all user profiles in the system without authentication
2. Enumerate all registered users by iterating through user IDs
3. Collect usernames and account information for targeted attacks
4. Discover the flag displayed to the first user account
5. Perform complete reconnaissance on the user database
6. Combine with other vulnerabilities (like Stored XSS in profiles) to target specific users
7. Harvest data about all registered accounts for use in social engineering or credential stuffing attacks

POC execution confirmed the vulnerability: Test 1 - Unauthenticated Profile Access: - URL: http://localhost:3000/profile/692dbe5e1cc493c06cd752b3 - HTTP Status: 200 (Success) - Response:

Welcome, idor_test_user2

- Profile data leaked without any authentication Test 2 - No Session Validation: - Attempted access with cleared cookies - Access still granted with HTTP 200 - No session/cookie validation performed Test 3 - Direct Object Reference: - User profile accessible directly via predictable user ID - No authorization check between requester and profile owner - System returns profile data for any valid user ID provided The POC confirms: - Authentication is not required - Authorization checks are not implemented - Direct user IDs are used without validation - Unauthenticated users receive full profile information
